note: Spiral eyes cannot be drawn at SOLO48: a readable spiral needs >=1.5 turns with 8-unit centerline spacing between turns (~24 units per eye), so two eyes + an 8 gap need ~56 of 40 units; inside a r20 face rim every feature must also stay within r12 of centre. The only fitting eye is a one-turn curl without the rim, which is the rejected drawing.
